description: This file contains shell script tests for verifying the behavior of shallow and non-shallow cloning of git repositories with submodules. It uses test-lib.sh for testing utilities and performs multiple git clone operations with different configurations to validate submodule cloning behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label and a series of shell commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be executed after tests complete.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Verifies the number of lines in the git log output.
